question: Which of the following expressions is correct?
solution: \(\sqrt{16}\) denotes the principal square root and equals 4; \(\pm\sqrt{16}\) denotes the two square roots of 16 and equals \(\pm4\); \(-\sqrt{16}=-4\). Therefore, only B is correct.
